title: VPC GitOps release assertions + smoke plan
content:
Purpose and scope:
This doc captures an operational runbook for performing GitOps-driven upgrades to VPC/on-prem clusters where customers run Redwood Private. It focuses on release assertions (what must be true before/after a promotion), a compact smoke test plan, and notes for Terraform/Helm module interactions and image provenance verification. Goal: reduce upgrade surprises and provide a repeatable checklist for on-call, SEs, and SREs during private release windows.

High-level flow (one-sentence):
1) prepare artifact bundle + sign -> 2) push to staging cluster via GitOps -> 3) run preflight assertions and smoke tests -> 4) promote to prod clusters -> 5) post-promotion validation and optional canary rollback.

Release roles and responsibilities:
- Release owner: Maya Chen (coordination, approvals)
- Infra lead: Arjun Patel (Terraform/cluster config)
- Release engineer: Lena Novak (Argo/Helm rollouts)
- Customer SE on-call: Diego Alvarez (customer-facing verification)
- Security reviewer (ad-hoc): Security team (image signing/KMS checks)

Prerequisites (artifact / infra):
- All images built and cosign-signed; attestation included where applicable. Use cosign with KMS: cosign sign --key <kms://...> <image>
- Terraform plan approved for any kernel/agent changes. Plan output must be attached to release issue.
- GitOps manifests in the private infra repo have a release branch and PR created for promotion.
- Helm charts version bumped and Chart.lock generated. Charts must include values schema for toggles used in release.
- Staging cluster with identical networking topology (VPC peering / transit gateway) for smoke validation.

Artifact provenance checklist (assertions that must be true before promotion):
- Image hash recorded and matches cosign entry: cosign verify --key <kms://...> <image> -> OK
- SBOM generated and attached to release ticket (syft format preferred).
- Git commit SHA for helm chart and values.yaml recorded in release metadata.
- Terraform module versions pinned (no un-audited floating versions).
- Image registry ACL allows read by target clusters (pre-warmed credentials).

Terraform module notes (quick reference):
- Module: private-cluster/networking: exposes variables: vpc_id, subnet_map, endpoint_access (public|private). Avoid changing endpoint_access mid-release.
- Module: private-cluster/agent: agent_version should track helm chart values.agent.tag. Use module input agent_tag = var.agent_tag so releases are explicit.
- Module: storage/encryption: ensure KMS ARN does not rotate during the release window; if KMS rotation is scheduled, reschedule preflight.

Helm & GitOps interaction patterns (recommendations):
- Keep values files per-cluster in git (values/staging.yaml values/prod-<region>.yaml). Promotion = merge release branch -> main which triggers Argo to sync.
- Use Helm hooks sparingly; prefer pre-install/post-install hooks only for one-off DB migrations run as one-time jobs with explicit wait-checks.
- When chart changes include CRD additions, perform a separate maintenance window: apply CRDs first (kubectl apply -f crds/) and wait 10m for operator status to be healthy before promoting controller changes.

Argo rollouts & strategies:
- Preferred: slow standard rolling upgrade with maxUnavailable: 10%, maxSurge: 0 for latency-sensitive endpoints.
- Canary option: use Argo Rollouts with 10% initial traffic -> 30m observation -> 50% -> full. Only use canary if customer SLOs allow and there is a rollback plan.

Image signing and verification steps (ops):
1) Build image and record digest: docker build -t registry/repo:sha-<short> .
2) Push image and run cosign sign with KMS + attach predicate: cosign sign --key kms://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/... --annotations "build_url=<ci_url>" registry/repo@sha256:<digest>
3) Verify: cosign verify --key kms://... registry/repo@sha256:<digest> and cosign verify-attestation --type wasm --attestation <predicate>
4) If verify fails, stop the release and open ticket GITOPS-212.

Preflight assertions (run after Argo sync to staging but before promoting to prod):
- k8s API sanity: kubectl get nodes; all nodes Ready and <10% NotReady events in last 30m.
- Deployments: all staging deployments at desired replicas (kubectl -n redwood rollout status deploy/<name> --watch=false).
- Logs smoke: error logs in last 5m < threshold (0 for critical services). Quick query: kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=<service> --since=5m | grep -i error
- Latency check: run 50 synthetic requests against staging endpoint; p95 < staging-slo (document per-customer).
- KV/prefix cache warm: for services relying on KV cache, run warmup script and ensure cache hit ratio > 60% in metrics.
- Secrets & KMS: ensure env var secrets decrypt: curl --header "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" http://staging-internal/health -> returns key_checksum:ok
- Image identity: deployed image digest equals recorded digest in release metadata.

Compact smoke test plan (20–30 min):
- Step 0: check Argo app sync status (argocd app get <app> -o json | jq .status.sync.status == "Synced").
- Step 1 (5m): run contract tests (small suite) against staging endpoint. Pass criteria: 100% critical test pass.
- Step 2 (10m): traffic test: replay 2 minutes of sampled production traffic to staging / synthetic traffic for rate-limiting sanity. Monitor CPU, memory, and error rate.
- Step 3 (5m): DB migration smoke (if applicable): run migration dry-run on snapshot database or run migration in canary namespace and verify schema.
- Step 4 (5m): ops checks: alerts suppressed? ensure paging thresholds are temporarily raised for noisy migrations but revert post-release.

Promotion checklist (before merging release branch to main):
- All preflight assertions green
- Release ticket has approvals (infra lead + security reviewer)
- Rollback plan documented with quick commands and target previous image digests
- Maintenance window and customer impact communicated to stakeholders and SEs

Promotion steps (execution):
1) Merge release branch -> main. This triggers Argo sync.
2) Wait for Argo to report Synced. If Argo cannot sync, open incident and revert PR immediately.
3) Run post-promotion smoke (same as staging steps) against prod- canary cluster or a single region.
4) Monitor SLOs for 30–60 minutes depending on risk profile.

Rollback triggers and fast rollback steps:
Common triggers:
- p95 latency spike > 2x baseline for > 10m
- Error rate > 1% for core endpoints
- Failed health checks across > 25% of nodes
Fast rollback steps:
- Argo app rollback: argocd app rollback <app> <previousRevision>
- If Argo rollback fails, enforce Helm rollback: helm rollback <release> <revision> --namespace redwood
- If both fail, scale down new replicaSet and scale up previous replicaSet: kubectl scale rs <newrs> --replicas=0; kubectl scale rs <oldrs> --replicas=<desired>
- After rollback, attach incident notes to release ticket and run RCA follow-up.

Observability checklist (on-call):
- Dashboards to watch: per-region token latency, per-route error rate, pod restart counts, infra CPU/GPU pressure, registry pull failures
- Log queries pre-populated in release ticket for fast triage
- SLOs and alert thresholds recorded in release ticket; ensure alert noise suppressed as appropriate.

Post-release:
- Run a short 24-hour health sweep: daily cron job to capture 24h post-release metrics and summarize regressions
- If any regression metrics exceed thresholds, schedule a rollback window or hotfix depending on severity.

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Decide on canonical SBOM location (artifact storage vs. ticket attachment) — action: security to recommend (Security-345).
- Add automated cosign attestation verification into ArgoCD pre-sync hook — P0 idea, needs implementation effort.
- Decide standard canary percent tiers per customer SLO class (ops-product roadmap item).

Quick commands (copypasta):
- Verify image: cosign verify --key kms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/release-key registry/repo@sha256:<digest>
- Argo app get: argocd app get rw-private-prod -o yaml | yq .status
- Helm history: helm history rw-private -n redwood | head
- Terraform plan: terraform plan -var-file=env/prod.tfvars -out=plan.tfplan

Appendix: small example of release metadata snippet to include in ticket (format free text):
- release_tag: 2025-02-25-private-1
- images:
  - service-a: registry/repo/service-a@sha256:abcd1234
  - controller: registry/repo/controller@sha256:efgh5678
- helm_chart: infra-charts/private-1.2.0 (commit: e7a12f)
- terraform: modules locked to v2025-02-10 (module-hash: 9a0b)

Notes: keep this doc lightweight and iterate. This is intentionally a pragmatic checklist for on-call/SE release execution rather than a deep design doc. If this pattern proves reliable, we will convert sections into automation (Argo pre-sync validation, CI gates) and create a canonical release playbook template.

Change log:
- 2025-01-10 created initial draft (Maya Chen)
- 2025-02-12 added Terraform module notes and rollback commands (Arjun Patel)
- 2025-02-25 added cosign KMS examples and tightened smoke-test timing (Lena Novak)
